messages.content: The airline moved our Kauai departure. Please verify the new times and make sure the rental pickup and resort arrival still work. I do not want anything rebooked unless there is an actual conflict.

The nonstop on record H7K2QM now leaves SFO at 8:10 a.m. on June 10, 35 minutes later than before, and arrives at LIH at 10:52 a.m. The return on June 17 is unchanged. Your seats and fare remain confirmed.
The rental is listed for 11:15. They warned me they release cars after the grace period. How close are we?

LIH6R28 has a two-hour grace period, so the vehicle is protected until 1:15 p.m. Allowing 20 minutes to deplane, 25 minutes for bags, and 15 minutes for the rental shuttle puts you at the counter around 11:52 a.m. Even with another 30-minute delay, you would arrive near 12:22 p.m., leaving 53 minutes before release.
Good. Add the revised flight arrival to the rental reservation. Then work out when we should reach the resort.

I added flight H7K2QM and the revised 10:52 a.m. arrival to LIH6R28; the rental price and vehicle class did not change. With counter time and loading, plan to drive away around 12:20 p.m. The drive to the resort is about 30 minutes, so a realistic arrival is 12:50-1:15 p.m.
The resort form wants a window, not an exact time. Use something with enough margin and confirm the included items are still documented.
I submitted a 1:00-2:00 p.m. arrival window for KB8F41. The confirmation still documents breakfast for two each morning and parking for the full stay; no rate or package terms changed.
Give me the final first-day schedule and flag the point when the rental would actually be at risk.

June 10: arrive at SFO in time for the confirmed 8:10 a.m. nonstop, land at LIH at 10:52 a.m., collect bags and take the rental shuttle, reach the counter around 11:52 a.m., and leave near 12:20 p.m. Expect the resort around 12:50-1:15 p.m., within the submitted 1:00-2:00 p.m. window. The car becomes at risk only if you have not reached the rental counter by 1:15 p.m.; if baggage or the shuttle pushes the estimate past 12:45 p.m., call the agency. No vacation booking was changed beyond adding the flight details and arrival window.
